title: Existence of a closed-fibre flat stage
statement: Under the hypotheses of the Noetherian local model tower and closed-fibre flatness, there exists one index at which the quotient tensor module is flat.

source.place: Algebra, proof of Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre), first two paragraphs; Closed-fibre flatness on a tail of a Noetherian local model tower

proof.text: Apply exists_fiber_diagram to X, without using h_fibre. Unpack the categorical quotient diagrams, their local and Noetherian stage instances, finite module instances, commuting ring squares, scalar compatibility, transition localization and module base-change witnesses, and stage and limit ring/additive comparisons.

Use Module.Flat.semilinearEquiv_iff with the limit ring and additive comparisons and their scalar compatibility. Its reverse implication transports the assumed flatness of the closed-fibre tensor module to flatness of colimit D over colimit A, with the action restricted along psi.

Apply RingTheory.exists_flat_stage to A,B,D, phi, psi and the unpacked hypotheses. Nonemptiness and directedness are the existing fields of X. This is the genuine second application of Tag 00R6 and yields an index i with D_i flat over A_i.

At the resulting index, unpack the stage ring and additive comparisons. The forward implication of Module.Flat.semilinearEquiv_iff transfers A_i-flatness of D_i to flatness of (S_i/m_i S_i) tensor_(S_i) N_i over S_i/m_i S_i. Return the same index.

proof_origin.place: Algebra, Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre), paragraph beginning with the colimit of the maximal ideals, quotient systems and transitions before the second application of Tag 00R6; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R7.

theorem NoetherianLocalModelTower.exists_fiberFlat_stage
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {S' : Type w} {M : Type t}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing S'] [IsLocalRing R] [AddCommGroup M]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra S S'] [Module S' M] [Module S M]
    [IsScalarTower S S' M]
    (X : NoetherianLocalModelTower R S S' M)
    (h_fibre : Module.Flat
      (S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R))
      ((S ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R S) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)) ⊗[S] M)) :
    letI := X.preorder
    letI := X.commR
    letI := X.commS
    letI := X.localR
    letI := X.algRS
    letI := X.addN
    letI := X.moduleS
    ∃ i : X.ι, Module.Flat
      (X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i)))
      ((X.S₀ i ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap (X.R₀ i) (X.S₀ i))
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.R₀ i))) ⊗[X.S₀ i] X.N₀ i)
